dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: Explicitly assessed softening, competing nitrides/disorder, code-model spin/SOC assumptions, mixed mass/potential/volume causes and coarse/fine residual-stress sensitivity. No observed critical sign contradiction reverses this bounded source coupled-intervention inference. Whole-BZ stability, disorder coherence, magnetic ground state and fixed-chemistry causal mediation remain unknown; the smaller/partially capacity-limited electronic envelopes are not claimed as W gains.
candidate.ambient_scope: Bounded near-ambient source feasibility: coarse pressure0 GPa, fine residual isotropic stress-0.178 GPa and printed-zero forces, finite q3^3/4irreducible response;21 Gamma optical-compression eigenvalues positive beyond printing bound and path no signed-negative values. Earlier PBE/PAW phase hull35 meV/atom is a metastability prior, not current NC exact hull or synthesis evidence.
candidate.route_response: Supported for the coupled minority-cation construction Sc->Y on a fixed sixfold network: lattice +1.92551688%, volume +5.888493%, first-shell M-N +0.04363518 A, together with favorable direct EPC. Atomic potential/mass and expansion are a coupled intervention; no isolated geometry-volume cause, topology change, high-W or mobile-n benefit is claimed.
candidate.next_action: Candidate grade3 is justified only for the declared source-model coupled atomic-construction/pairing domain. A fixed-chemistry cross-volume response and named finite-q stationarity check are the next falsifiers; independent numerical/causal strengthening needed for grade4. Formal research-action RPS/publication remains separate.

seven_criteria.identity: Exact ideal ordered8-site source input is pinned; actual cubic-coordinate arithmetic links SCF coarse/fine, species, source Gamma tau and periodic CIF sites. Exact input/run QE7.0 model defaults are resolved from official tag source. Physical sample spin/occupancy/T remains unknown.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Supported for the coupled minority-cation construction Sc->Y on a fixed sixfold network: lattice +1.92551688%, volume +5.888493%, first-shell M-N +0.04363518 A, together with favorable direct EPC. Atomic potential/mass and expansion are a coupled intervention; no isolated geometry-volume cause, topology change, high-W or mobile-n benefit is claimed.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: All10 matched printed source-width EPC responses favor Y with lambda +57.052–81.045%; phonon frequency softening is preserved. Independent source Eliashberg mu*=0.1 estimates21.437 versus16.568 K support the source-model pairing contrast; neither a new child calculation nor experiment. Sigma table and Eliashberg estimator are not silently merged.

seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: Explicitly assessed softening, competing nitrides/disorder, code-model spin/SOC assumptions, mixed mass/potential/volume causes and coarse/fine residual-stress sensitivity. No observed critical sign contradiction reverses this bounded source coupled-intervention inference. Whole-BZ stability, disorder coherence, magnetic ground state and fixed-chemistry causal mediation remain unknown; the smaller/partially capacity-limited electronic envelopes are not claimed as W gains.
seven_criteria.novelty: Exact composition/phase hypothesis not among current5 reviewed groups. The2023 published prediction of SG221 YZr3N4 is explicitly retained; bounded primary search does not establish an experimental superconducting benchmark for this state. Count only one new-to-reviewed-catalogue Y composition hypothesis, not parentSc/reference, first discovery, a new composition in literature or a trivial cell alias.

A fixed-chemistry cross-volume response and named finite-q stationarity check are the next falsifiers; independent numerical/causal strengthening needed for grade4. Formal research-action RPS/publication remains separate.
